title: Miami-Dade County Now Accepts Bitcoin for Property Taxes
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Miami-Dade County Now Accepts Bitcoin for Property Taxes Miami-Dade Tax Collector Dariel Fernandez said Monday his office now accepts bitcoin for property taxes online and in person, with every payment converted to dollars before it reaches the county. This post Miami-Dade County Now Accepts Bitcoin for Property Taxes first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
